about: GVC's FOLD stage (ladder_gvc.py): the happening record's declared field, and the gold mention type each declared value names. Values are the frozen end-to-end recipe's own (baseline-3sys-20261009/recipes/cdcr-gvc-e2e.toml, attribute `kind`); gold types are cdcr/prepare.py's. A gold type listed as unfoldable has no declared value, so its fold is could-not-judge.
